description: The January 8 Prague Castle gathering is clearly pre-election candidate support. The opened reports identify civic-group organizer Milion Chvilek and supporters of multiple candidates, but do not establish the codebook definition of an excluded political rally: two or more political parties demonstrating for their positions in association with upcoming elections. The Castle Administration relocation recommendation and dispute over public-space status could also raise an assembly-right/state-target issue, but the reports do not establish a demand directed at state authorities about it.
required_followup: Coordinator should check whether contemporaneous evidence shows two or more political parties demonstrating for their positions and whether participants made a distinct demand about the relocation recommendation or public access to the Castle site. Keep the worker exclusion provisional until these questions are resolved.
